'The next attack action card you play this turn gains +2{p}. **Go again**' Yellow printing (+2{p}); shape copied verbatim from the sibling .drafts/come_to_fight_red.json (+3) / come_to_fight_blue.json (+1), which follows shipped wtr/nimblism_red.json - same sentence family, proven spelling. Every handler re-read from source this session.

GO AGAIN NOT AUTHORED: it is in printed_keywords as an UNCONDITIONAL line of the text, so it fires from the card DB keywords field - re-authoring it would be a defect. (No conditional-keyword machinery needed: that is only for a PRINTED keyword gated on a condition, via SOURCE_IS_ATTACK.)

FILTER NAMES 'ATTACK ACTION CARD' precisely: ATTACK_TYPE_IN reads 'types' and tests the attack card's types AND subtypes merged (condition_types.py:273-294); ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN reads 'subtypes' (:296-302). An attack action card is types=['Action'], subtypes=['Attack']; a weapon attack is types=['Weapon'] and fails the Action test, so the buff cannot land on a weapon attack - matching the printed 'attack action card'.

'THE NEXT ... THIS TURN': MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK handler (effect_types.py:4592-4618) READS mod/amount/filter/scope and queues a one-shot entry on the CONTROLLER's dsl_queued_attack_mods, consumed by the first later attack whose filter matches; an attack played that fails the filter leaves the entry queued, and unused entries expire end of turn - exactly 'this turn'. Scope left at default TURN.

No gaps; every clause expressible.
